author: Maudeth
body:
A decent sized and active kingdom helps. Grinding with friends and like minded individuals. 

Also having get togethers outside the game. (If your area/state allows. Mine does, and I regularly get together with 4 or 5 players over lunch/dinner)

Find a rival, pick territory fights. 

Just a few suggestions. 

Grats in 229.

author: JaffaBeard
body: Burn out is real and I've found taking breaks helps. Getting to 230 will take a while so try finding other goals. Smaller goals. Like hitting a certain number of gauntlets, your regional pvp leader board position, aiming to farm a piece of gear you're missing, missing achievements, rounding off other stats, reaching higher endless gauntlet level, unlocking missing classes.

author: emdeemcd
body:
Only play when you feel like playing.

Stop playing when you get bored.

Then you'll never feel like you're forced to play.

Orna is a game to be played, not a game to be beaten.
